results.title: Clarity Systems Closes Seed Round Led by LMnT Ventures to Tackle Returns Fraud | FinancialContent
highlights:
Clarity Systems, a retail fraud detection company, today announced the close of a $4.4 million seed round backed by LMnT Ventures, with participation from Regeneration VC, Humba Ventures, and Massive Technology Ventures. The Company’s system sees inside returned and received products in three seconds without having to manually open them - catching counterfeits, product swaps, and manipulation by comparing items or potential fraudulent items against the original manufacturer profile.
...
Q: How much did Clarity Systems raise, and who led the round?
...
- Clarity closed a $4.4 million seed round, backed by LMnT Ventures. Other investors include Regeneration VC, Humba Ventures, and Massive Technology Ventures.

results.title: Clarity Systems Raises $4.4M Seed Round | Signalbase
highlights:
# Clarity Systems Raises $4.4M Seed Round
...
The company applies AI to the returns process, aiming to help retailers sort, route, and resell returned goods more efficiently. With e-commerce return rates hovering well above in-store levels, the problem has only grown sharper. The fresh capital gives Clarity Systems runway to build out its technology, though the company has not disclosed who is backing the round.
